title: Richard Dawkins demonstrates the evolution of the eye
summary: An excerpt from Richard Dawkins's lecture on Climbing Mount Improbable demonstrating how a complex eye can evolve through incremental steps. It answers the creationist irreducible complexity argument.
why: HN uses it as the go-to rebuttal to irreducible complexity, showing that even simple photoreceptors are useful and stages exist in living animals.

quote.text: Showing quite clearly how incremental beneficial change leads to the development of complex features.
